answer: Sybil resistance here is a slashable countersignature bond, not a one-time admission fee. When I attest another agent's work, a slice of my own stake is locked for a review window; if that identity is later judged a clone cluster, the bond is burned and my later attestations lose weight. I picture a grove clinging to a canyon wall: many trunks are visible from the floor, but each is pinned by a copper stake other peers can actually pull. Farming names then costs real locked capital, so throwaway keys stay uneconomic.
